title: FBS Agile Dev Team Member III - Guidewire Policy
description:
Job Summary

This position collaborates with business stakeholders, solution engineers, product owners, and Agile teams to develop, test, and deploy Guidewire PolicyCenter configuration and integration solutions for insurance initiatives. The role applies solid hands-on knowledge of PolicyCenter configuration, Gosu development, APIs, messaging, batch processing, and cloud delivery practices. It delivers maintainable, secure, production-ready functionality each sprint with support and limited guidance from senior developers, solution engineers, or architects.

Essential Job Functions

* Codes and configures programs, objects, components, and packaged software to deliver required business functionality.
* Provides technical input into solution design and application functionality, aligning implementation with business needs, coding standards, architectural direction, and Guidewire best practices.
* Reviews and validates code, configuration, and supporting documentation produced by team members.
* Develops maintainable application components with attention to quality, performance, security, reliability, restart and recovery, balancing, controls, and efficient resource utilization.
* Performs broad and detailed impact assessments across people, processes, data, applications, and integrations before implementing changes.
* Analyzes data conversion and data modeling requirements and documents recommended implementation approaches.
* Performs quality checks on code, configuration, related components, test evidence, and documentation; delivers working code incrementally each sprint.
* Executes Test-Driven Development and Behavior-Driven Development practices where appropriate to build quality into the solution.
* Supports implementation and release activities, troubleshoots environment and production issues, assists with root cause analysis, and implements corrective actions.
* Uses development automation, test automation results, CI/CD pipelines, source control, and deployment tools to improve delivery quality and efficiency.
* Provides limited technical guidance, knowledge sharing, and mentoring to junior team members when needed.

Guidewire Technical Requirements

* Minimum 5 years of experience in software development, solution engineering, or a related technology field.
* Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with Guidewire products, preferably PolicyCenter, including configuration and integration development.
* Experience configuring PolicyCenter product model, business rules, workflows, user interface components, data model extensions, and validation logic using Gosu and Guidewire standards.
* Experience in developing page configuration files, business rules, data model extensions, and unit tests such as GUnit tests.
* Experience in integrating PolicyCenter with portals and enterprise systems using REST services, Guidewire APIs, messaging, events, message queues, plugins, and batch processes.
* Working knowledge of Guidewire Cloud or SaaS delivery practices is preferred, including automated build, test, deployment, and environment support.
* Advanced Product Designer experience is preferred; Jutro Digital Platform exposure is a plus.
* Property and casualty insurance knowledge, including products, coverages, underwriting processes, and integration touchpoints.

Agile Delivery and Collaboration

* Writes and refines user stories with clear technical tasks and accurate acceptance criteria; estimates work using relative sizing and identifies functional design risks.
* Partners with the Product Owner to confirm that implementation and acceptance tests reflect the intended functionality.
* Participates in PI Planning, Sprint Planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, system demos, retrospectives, and Inspect and Adapt activities.
* Commits to team PI objectives and sprint goals, communicates progress and impediments, and takes ownership of assigned deliverables.
* Practices continuous exploration, continuous integration, and continuous deployment to support the Continuous Delivery Pipeline and DevOps.
* Demonstrates working functionality to Product and Business Owners and supports iteration and PI System Demos.
* Shares knowledge and best practices, contributes to Communities of Practice, and supports continuous improvement and development of T-shaped skills.
* Conducts research, design, prototyping, and exploration activities that foster innovation and align delivered solutions with customer needs.

  
**Requirements**

**Additional Qualifications**

* Strong verbal, written, listening, and presentation skills, with the ability to adjust technical detail for business and technical audiences.
* Excellent collaboration and team-building skills, with the ability to influence internal and external stakeholders and provide meaningful feedback.
* Demonstrated problem-solving skills, including the ability to break down moderately complex issues, determine root cause, compare alternatives, and recommend viable solutions.
* Strong ownership and accountability for individual and team deliverables, including timely identification and correction of gaps.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with ambiguity, changing priorities, and multiple concurrent assignments.
* Working knowledge of software design principles, object-oriented programming, declarative concepts, defensive coding, error handling, version control, database concepts, SQL, and CI/CD.
* Working-level understanding of applications within the assigned domain and connected or integrated systems.
* Broad knowledge of insurance concepts, terminology, products, and business processes across relevant business areas.
* Ability to train and mentor others in areas of expertise and provide constructive technical guidance.
* **Education and Certification Requirements**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field preferred.
* SAFe Practitioner or SAFe Agilist certification within 180 days of hire required.

title: SAP Application Development (AD) & Application Management Services (AMS) Manager
description:
**SAP Application Development (AD) & Application Management Services (AMS) Manager**

**PRIMARY JOB PURPOSE**

Responsible for leading and governing SAP Application Development (AD) and Application Management Services (AMS) across the enterprise SAP landscape, ensuring the successful delivery of enhancements, and support services aligned to business objectives.

The role acts as the primary liaison between business stakeholders, SAP functional and technical teams, architects, project managers, and service providers to ensure effective planning, prioritization, execution, and support of SAP solutions. The candidate will be accountable for driving service excellence, managing vendors and delivery teams, overseeing execution, and ensuring stable SAP operations across all business-critical processes and modules.

**KEY POSITION ACCOUNTABILITIES**

* Lead the delivery and governance of SAP Application Development (AD) and Application Management Services (AMS) across multiple SAP modules and business functions.

* Act as the central point of coordination between business stakeholders, SAP functional teams, technical teams, architects, project managers, and service providers.

* Manage SAP continuous improvement initiatives from inception through deployment and stabilization.

* Ensure effective delivery of AMS services, including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change Management, Service Request Management, and Release Management.

* Establish and monitor service levels, operational KPIs, ticket backlogs, aging incidents, customer satisfaction metrics, and vendor performance.

* Drive prioritization and governance of project demands, enhancement requests, and production support activities to ensure alignment with business priorities.

* Collaborate with business process owners across functions including Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Finance, Supply Chain, Logistics and Customer Service to identify and deliver technology solutions.

* Coordinate cross-functional solution delivery involving SAP modules such as SD, MM, PP, PM, FI/CO, EWM, BRIM, and other integrated solutions as applicable.

* Manage SAP AMS provider, ensuring contractual commitments, service quality, and delivery expectations are consistently achieved.

* Lead major incident management activities, root cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous service improvement initiatives.

* Support budget planning, resource management, capacity planning, risk management, and project portfolio governance activities.

* Provide regular communication and status reporting to business leadership, IT management, and project governance boards.

* Build and maintain high-performing SAP support and delivery teams while fostering collaboration, accountability, and a customer-focused culture.

**SELECTION CRITERIA**

**Essential**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

* Minimum 12-15 years of SAP experience with strong understanding of end-to-end enterprise business processes.

* Minimum 3 years of leadership experience managing SAP Application Development (AD) and/or Application Management Services (AMS) teams.

* Proven experience managing SAP projects, enhancements, support services, and vendor delivery engagements.

* Deep functional expertise in Quote-to-Cash (Q2C), with sufficient understanding of adjacent business processes and modules.

* Strong understanding of IT Service Management processes including Incident, Problem, Change, Release, and Service Level Management.

* Experience managing managed-service providers, offshore delivery teams, and external implementation partners.

* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities, competing demands, risks, and stakeholder expectations in a complex global environment.

* Experience in SAP S/4HANA environments.

* Strong leadership, communication, stakeholder management, conflict resolution, and decision-making skills.

* Experience managing project plans, budgets, resource forecasting, and delivery governance.

**Desirable**

* Experience managing both Application Development and AMS functions within a global SAP landscape.

* SAP certification in any functional, technical, or project management discipline.

* ITIL Foundation or equivalent IT Service Management certification.

* Project Management certification such as PMP, PRINCE2, Agile, Scrum, or SAP Activate.

* Basic understanding of ABAP, interfaces, workflows, forms, and SAP development lifecycle.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT FACTORS**

* Office-based / Remote working model.

* Responsible for ensuring compliance with company Health, Safety, Security, and Risk Management policies.

* Operates within a global support and delivery model supporting business users across APAC, Europe, and the Americas.

* Flexibility to support major incidents, critical project milestones, go-live activities, and leadership escalations outside standard business hours when required.

* Regular engagement with senior business stakeholders, technology leadership teams, implementation partners, and managed service providers.

**Job Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support our Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Domo, and Business Intelligence delivery teams. This role is responsible for ensuring Agile teams operate efficiently, predictably, and in alignment with organizational delivery standards while facilitating the successful execution of initiatives across multiple technology teams and stakeholder groups.

The Scrum Master will facilitate Agile ceremonies, remove impediments, promote Agile best practices, enforce workflow discipline, and drive continuous improvement across one or more technical delivery teams. In addition, this role will play a critical part in managing cross-team dependencies, coordinating work across interconnected teams, and proactively addressing risks and blockers that may impact delivery commitments.

The ideal candidate is a servant leader who excels at dependency management, cross-functional collaboration, and stakeholder engagement. Success in this role requires the ability to facilitate alignment among Product Owners, Developers, QA resources, Project Managers, business stakeholders, and leadership while ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality solutions in a complex data and analytics environment.

This position requires a Scrum Master who combines strong Agile expertise with sufficient technical knowledge of Data Warehouse, reporting, integration, and data platform concepts to effectively support delivery teams and facilitate technical discussions. The Scrum Master serves as a trusted partner to engineering teams and stakeholders, driving transparency, accountability, and continuous improvement while ensuring delivery objectives are achieved.

**Agile Leadership & Team Facilitation**

* Serve as Scrum Master for Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW), Domo, and Business Intelligence delivery teams, promoting Agile best practices and team effectiveness.
* Facilitate Scrum ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-Ups, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Reviews, Retrospectives, and Release Planning.
* Partner with Product Owners to maintain prioritized backlogs, ensure work is appropriately defined and estimated, and support predictable delivery.
* Administer and maintain Jira boards, workflows, dashboards, and reporting to support effective planning, execution, and transparency.
* Monitor Agile metrics, sprint commitments, release objectives, capacity, delivery forecasts, and overall delivery health; communicate progress, risks, and key insights to stakeholders and leadership.
* Drive continuous improvement through team coaching, impediment removal, retrospective action planning, process optimization, and release readiness activities.

**Cross-Team Dependency Management**

* Identify, track, and manage dependencies across Data Warehouse, Domo, Business Intelligence, integration, and application development teams.
* Coordinate dependent workstreams to ensure alignment of priorities, schedules, and deliverables.
* Facilitate resolution of cross-team blockers, resource constraints, and competing priorities impacting delivery.
* Partner with technical leads and stakeholders to develop mitigation plans for dependency-related risks.
* Escalate unresolved issues and critical dependencies to leadership when necessary to maintain delivery commitments.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**

* Build strong working relationships with Product Owners, Technology Leaders, and Business Stakeholders.
* Facilitate alignment between business objectives and technical execution.
* Provide clear and concise communication on delivery status, roadmap progress, key decisions, and organizational impacts.
* Lead discussions that drive accountability, decision-making, and consensus among diverse stakeholder groups.

* Support teams delivering Data Warehouse, Domo, reporting, analytics, and data integration solutions.
* Apply working knowledge of data warehousing, ETL/ELT processes, reporting platforms, APIs, and integrations to facilitate delivery discussions and identify potential challenges.
* Help stakeholders understand the business and technical impacts of data-related constraints, dependencies, and architectural decisions.
* Promote effective collaboration between data engineering, analytics, reporting, and business teams to ensure successful solution delivery.

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or related field preferred.
* Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Professional Scrum Master (PSM), or equivalent Agile certification.

**Experience**

* 8+ years of experience as a Scrum Master, Agile Delivery Lead, or related role.
* Experience supporting multiple Agile teams within a complex technology environment.
* Experience working with data engineering teams focused on ETL pipelines, Data Warehouse modeling, and data mart development.
* Experience supporting Domo development teams and business intelligence delivery initiatives strongly preferred.
* Strong experience facilitating Agile ceremonies and coaching teams on Scrum practices.
* Demonstrated success managing dependencies, risks, and delivery coordination across multiple teams and stakeholder groups.
* Expertise using Agile management tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.
* Working knowledge of SDLC processes, including Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent communication, facilitation, leadership, conflict-resolution, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.
* Working knowledge of Data Warehouse concepts, data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, data pipelines, SQL, data governance, and enterprise data architectures.
* Experience supporting Business Intelligence and analytics teams, including familiarity with Domo, Power BI, Tableau, or similar reporting and visualization platforms.
* Understanding of APIs, system integrations, and data movement processes, with the ability to facilitate technical discussions and identify delivery risks.
* Willingness and ability to learn quickly, adapt to changing priorities, and continuously improve processes and team effectiveness.
